+title: 'Shared object inspector: Inspectable + Inspection builder + .inspect(_:)'
+---
+Requested by EditorKit (editorkit-b5); the user approved the design. Owned by AVK.
+
+## Why
+KVK, SVK and Testudo each hand-build inspectors on `InspectorForm` (Sources/AgentViewKitStyle/Inspector/InspectorForm.swift) with no shared field model. We want to inspect the @Observable view models of FoundationModelsACPClient (SessionModel, ToolCallEntry, TerminalEntry, …) and the GraphQL-backed models of KVK (BoardTask) and SVK (CheckpointModel) the same way. User rules: **no reflection, no attributes/macros — plain blocks.** (Probed: Mirror on @Observable sees `_title` storage and its reads are not observation-tracked; a block reading `$0.title` inside the row body IS tracked, so rows update live for free.)
+
+## API (AgentViewKitStyle)
+```swift
+@MainActor public protocol Inspectable: AnyObject {
+  static var inspection: Inspection<Self> { get }
+}
+
+extension ToolCallEntry: Inspectable {        // ACPClient conformances live in AVK
+  public static var inspection: Inspection<ToolCallEntry> {
+    Inspection {
+      FieldGroup("Tool call") {
+        Field("Name") { $0.name }
+        Field("Status") { $0.status }
+          .display { StatusBadge($0) }
+        Field("Started") { $0.timing.start }
+          .help("When the agent started the call")
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+// GraphQL-backed (KVK writes this):
+Field("Title") { $0.title }
+  .editing { task, title in try await task.board.rename(task, to: title) }
+Field("Column") { $0.columnName }
+  .choices { task in task.board.columns.map(\.name) }
+  .editing { task, column in try await task.board.move(task, to: column) }
+
+BoardView(board).inspect(selectedTask)          // one, or nil → themed empty state
+            .inspect(selectedTasks)             // several → "Mixed"
+            .inspect(entry, ToolCallEntry.inspection.adding { FieldGroup("Session") { … } })
+InspectorForm(inspecting: selection)            // same form, host places it (Testudo panes)
+```
+
+## Builder
+- `@InspectionBuilder<Object>` → groups; `@FieldBuilder<Object>` → fields; both support `if`/`else`, optionals and `for`. Names `FieldGroup`/`Field` avoid SwiftUI `Group`/`Section`.
+- `Field(label) { get }`: row kind from value type — String text, Bool toggle, numbers, Date, CaseIterable enums as choice, [String] as list, Optional shows empty-value dash. Anything else needs `.display { value in View }`.
+- Chained modifiers returning Field: `.editing { object, value in try await … }` (absent = read-only), `.choices { object in … }`, `.help(_:)`, `.visible { object in Bool }`, `.display { … }`, `.identifier(_:)` (default a11y id derived from group + label).
+- Inspection composition: `.adding { … }`, `.removing(_ label:)`, `.replacing(_ label:) { Field … }`.
+
+## Behavior
+- Get blocks run in the row body so Observation tracks them.
+- `.editing` runs on commit via EditorKit `onEditorCommit` edit sessions, never per keystroke. Text rows use EditorKit `SingleLineField` (style.md "Text input").
+- Edit blocks are `async throws`; on throw the row shows the refusal and reverts to the model's value.
+- Several objects: Value: Equatable. Differing values show "Mixed" (Testudo D45); an edit applies to every object.
+- `.inspect` puts the form in the system `.inspector` column (style.md rule 1, "The inspector") inside the `/window/inspector` command scope (EditorKit FocusPath inspector wall), on chrome (`.onChrome()`).
+- Look is InspectorForm + InspectorActionRow: grouped form, LabeledContent rows, `ui` font, no padding of its own.
+
+## Acceptance
+- [ ] ACPClient models (SessionModel, ToolCallEntry, TerminalEntry, …) conform in AVK.
+- [ ] Decide whether AttachmentInspector moves onto it.
+- [ ] Hosted tests: live update on model change; read-only vs editable; refused edit reverts; Mixed with two objects; edit applies to all; `if`/`for` in the builder; empty state.
+- [ ] Screenshots in the gallery, light and dark.
+- [ ] When on origin: message the SHA directly to kanbanviewkit-6d, snapshotviewkit-45 and testudoapp-bf (they are waiting; they should `swift package update` all deps together).
+- EditorKit needs no change. If something does (commit editing, focus scope), tell editorkit-b5.
\ No newline at end of file
